title: The Second Measure
author: A Milewarden's field note
text:
This stone was measured twice. The first surveyor counted the road from {city_name}. The second counted the footsteps of everyone who had walked it.

Their figures disagreed. Their stone did not move.

The margin names {dungeon_name}. A Milewarden has added: I am taking a fresh sheet. If the old surveyors kept a third account there, I mean to bring a copy home.
